name: Erwin
slug: New Navel man who won 25 gold betting the Trigash beacon was the stronghold hooligans.
description: Erwin was in New Navel when the Trigash beacon went up. He is not present for the later conversation with Haldor.

log.summary: Erwin bet Haldor 25 gold that the Trigash beacon was the stronghold hooligans rather than a random event. He saw a bunch of the party fly toward the forest with a new dragon in tow, then fly back about an hour later. Haldor lost and owes him the money.
